tokens.name: desk
tokens.usage: Page background behind tickets and panels. Ticket perforation notches are painted in desk.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Tickets, panels, inputs, the site and app bars.

tokens.name: sunk
tokens.usage: Code blocks, refs, inset wells and side notes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body text on desk, paper and sunk (16:1+). Fill of the primary button.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary copy and transcript answers on desk, paper and sunk (7:1+).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Meta, mono labels, timestamps and line numbers on desk, paper and sunk (5.3:1+).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, card and ticket borders, the perforation dashes, empty XP track and locked badges. Decorative only.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input, choice and secondary-button borders; dashed outline of Not shown chips (3:1+ on desk and paper).

tokens.name: hivis
tokens.usage: The brand orange: the mark, the one commitment button per screen, Live chips, the current step, XP fills, the stripe on earned badges. Never text on paper.

tokens.name: on-hivis
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a hivis fill (5.2:1).

tokens.name: hivis-text
tokens.usage: Orange as text: ticket IDs, gap names, Partial and Unknown chips, on paper, desk and hivis-tint (5.3:1+).

tokens.name: hivis-tint
tokens.usage: Background of Partial and Unknown chips, XP reward chips, the highlighted code line and marked words in a transcript.

tokens.name: sheen
tokens.usage: Hi-vis tape stripes drawn over a hivis fill (XP bars). Never on its own.

tokens.name: proof
tokens.usage: Observed evidence and confirmed payment: icon and text on paper and proof-tint (5.5:1+). Diff + signs.

tokens.name: proof-tint
tokens.usage: Background of Observed and Confirmed chips and added diff lines.

tokens.name: review
tokens.usage: Human review and pending states, links: text and icon on paper and review-tint (6.4:1+).

tokens.name: review-tint
tokens.usage: Background of Pending chips.

tokens.name: alert
tokens.usage: Failed or declined payment, form errors, diff - signs; text on paper and alert-tint (5.5:1+).

tokens.name: alert-tint
tokens.usage: Background of Failed chips and removed diff lines.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus ring with 2px offset on every interactive element (6.8:1+ on all grounds).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind dialogs such as the locker.

families.sans: "IBM Plex Sans", "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif
families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Archivo from Google Fonts at font-stretch 112% (SemiExpanded). Load wdth 100..125, wght 600..800.

styles.name: type-display-xl
styles.usage: The landing hero, once per page. Scales down to 40px on phones.

styles.name: type-display-l
styles.sample: Do the work. Defend the work.

styles.name: type-title
styles.usage: Screen titles, ticket titles, trust headings.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: IBM Plex Sans; Plex Sans Arabic follows in the stack for Arabic copy.

styles.name: type-body-lg
styles.sample: Graduates get a real work task and defend the decisions behind it.

styles.name: type-body
styles.sample: The interviewer has read your submission and will ask about it.

styles.name: type-body-sm
styles.sample: You’ll finish payment on Paymob’s secure page.

groups.name: Utility
groups.note: IBM Plex Mono for anything that comes from the machine.

styles.name: type-label
styles.usage: Eyebrows and field meta. Always uppercase.

styles.name: type-ref
styles.usage: Source citations, ticket IDs, order numbers.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text in refs, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip and button gaps, label-to-value.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gaps inside tickets and panels.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Phone gutter, evidence row padding, small panel padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Ticket and panel padding, stacks of form fields.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Column gaps, desktop gutter.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section head to content.

tokens.name: space-18
tokens.usage: Section padding on phones.

tokens.name: radius-s
tokens.usage: Refs, inputs, small code chips.

tokens.name: radius-m
tokens.usage: Buttons, code blocks, choice cards.

tokens.name: radius-l
tokens.usage: Tickets and panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status chips and demo toggles.

tokens.name: shadow-ticket
tokens.usage: Tickets, toasts, the locker dialog and the shift-complete panel. Panels stay flat.

tokens.name: display-stretch
tokens.usage: font-stretch for every Archivo display style (SemiExpanded).
